---
title: "Please select your age"
question_id: socio3_0
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "socio3_0"
response_levels <- c(
  "18 to 24 years",
  "25 to 34 years",
  "35 to 44 years",
  "45 to 54 years",
  "55 to 64 years",
  "Age 65 or older",
  "Prefer not to say"
)


df <- load_filtered_tf(plot_countries)
likert_cols <- question_code
```

## `r filter_label`

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(FILTER)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  levels = response_levels,
  empty_message = paste0("No responses available for ", filter_label, " in the current filter.")
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| eval: !expr show_within
cat("## Within ", filter_label, "

", sep = "")
```


```{r}
#| eval: !expr show_within
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(FILTER)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  group_by = FILTER,
  levels = response_levels,
  empty_message = paste0("No responses available for ", filter_label, " in the current filter.")
)
```

## Between Countries

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| results: asis

print_likert_items(
  df,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  country_groups = country_groups,

)
```
